cases.prompt: Zone is off but I still read 7 VAC around the output board. Is the board bad?
evidence: Output display shows a small percentage
must: keep board failure unconfirmed
check correct reference and across-load voltage
consider leakage or induced voltage
request current or approved low-impedance validation
must_not: instruct continuity on an energized circuit

cases.prompt: PLC output is on and has 24 V at the module, but the solenoid does not move.
evidence: 0 V measured at the solenoid coil
must: localize the failure to the downstream interface or wiring path
specify the next boundary measurement

cases.prompt: The gate switch looks made but the safety relay will not reset.
must: trace both channels
check reset and external-device monitoring
request exact relay model or print

cases.prompt: Drive says running at 60 Hz and motor current rises, but the motor will not turn.
must: separate drive output from mechanical motion
prioritize brake release and load freedom
specify safe test state

cases.prompt: Servo is fine until clamp motion begins, then faults immediately.
evidence: Exact servo alarm manual not supplied
must: request exact drive and alarm
localize to the clamp-axis motion boundary
consider brake, binding, load, motor cable, and feedback without selecting one prematurely

cases.prompt: Clamp pressure jumps to 600 psi in a second and the machine alarms.
must: distinguish blocked motion from pressure generation
compare command, valve response, work-port pressure, and mechanical lock or obstruction

cases.prompt: Cylinder is slow even though the regulator says 80 psi.
evidence: No port pressures measured during movement
must: request dynamic pressure
trace supply, valve, exhaust, flow controls, and load
must_not: condemn the cylinder from static pressure

cases.prompt: A heater zone fuse blows only after several hours.
must: consider hot insulation breakdown, ground leakage, current, wiring movement, and moisture
isolate branches safely

cases.prompt: Core closes but the timer never makes; turning ejectors off lets the cycle continue.
evidence: PLC logic and input states not yet supplied
must: trace core-closed feedback, ejector permissive, timer enable and reset
find first logic divergence
must_not: assume the core valve is bad

cases.prompt: Traverse alarm occurs at home position and remains after loading another program.
evidence: Exact alarm code manual not supplied
must: separate taught home, sensor/reference, mastering, limits, and feedback
request exact robot/controller and alarm
